# Backspace Fork 1.15.2

Source preparation only: publication and deployment have not been authorized.

## Changes

- **Strict borderless Windows Force SDR:** screen sharing prepares Windows
  borderless permission before capture. Denied, unavailable or unconfigurable
  borderless capture blocks the affected share instead of silently falling back
  to a bordered/raw video stream. Cancellation and stale source selections
  cannot restart a retired capture.
- **Explicit permission retry:** the setup offers “Solicitar permissão
  novamente” for retryable permission failures. A retry revalidates the source;
  Windows may retain its previous decision and is not guaranteed to show a new
  dialog. Force SDR remains a saved, opt-in preference.
- **Hub and Explore removed:** no project-hub page, discovery previews, global
  space-directory feed, proxy, listing document or pinger remains. Old bookmarks
  redirect to Friends. Legacy directory configuration cannot restart traffic.
- **Invitations retained:** Join Space accepts invitation codes/URLs, including
  remote connection/password fallback and manager approval. Space Overview
  retains visibility and description. Existing accounts, messages, memberships,
  uploads and federation credentials are preserved; historical database columns
  remain inert for rollback.
- Social Discover People, explicit Connections, sticker limits, source/version
  attribution and desktop updates/recovery remain independent and available.

## Acceptance limitations

Local native x64/runtime and production-adapter lifecycle checks do not replace
installed-app or receiver acceptance. Windows NSIS grant/deny/retry, system-audio
capture, ARM64 GPU/runtime and received HDR-to-SDR comparison remain pending.
The full borderless fixture is blocked by `NotReadableError: Could not start
audio source`, also reproduced without the native module. No complete audio or
installed-package success is claimed.

An intermittent federation presence assertion was also reproduced on the
unchanged 1.15.1 baseline; see the validation record for full-suite outcomes.
This source is **not declared release-accepted**. The production desktop minimum
remains disabled; no tag, public assets or server deployment is created here.

Removing this application's directory does not prove deletion of historical
listings from external caches. Corresponding Source remains available in the
[fork repository](https://github.com/bernardokcosta/backspace) under AGPL-3.0.
